messages:
Riley Park: Quick design thread for the latency panel tweak. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/latency-horizon

Summary:
- Add a faint vertical 'horizon' marker on the heatmap to show the p95 time for selected range.
- Move sampling control into the top toolbar as a compact mini-slider (label: Sampling) with preset chips 0/10/25/100 and a small chevron for custom.
- When sampling is enabled show a pill: 'Sampled' + percent. If percent <5% pill turns orange and tooltip says 'Low confidence.'
- Keyboard: propose single-key shortcut 'S' to focus the sampling control; Left/Right nudge, Shift+Left/Right for larger steps.
- Microcopy options for the pill tooltip: A) 'Sampled: results approximate.' B) 'Sampled: view shows a subset of traffic; numbers are approximate.' Leaning A for brevity.

June Kim: I like the horizon marker, helps orientation when switching ranges. A few notes:
- Make the horizon marker non-interactive but reachable by screen readers with descriptive text (e.g., 'p95 marker at 220ms').
- Slider needs >=44px hit target and visible numeric readout next to it for screen readers.
- For the pill, prefer 'Sampled  10%' (use a dot separator) and tooltip B for clarity to non-technical users.

Marco Li: Implementation notes from infra:
- We need to include sampling_percent in the query metadata so backends can tag results.
- If horizon marker is drawn from sampled data, annotate it with an asterisk and show a short note: '* estimated from sample'.
- Telemetry: log when users use the 'S' shortcut to understand discoverability.

Gwen Ortiz: Accessibility + visual nits:
- Pill contrast must meet AA; dark text on pale pill works best. If orange low-confidence state is used, ensure text contrast against orange meets AA.
- Horizon line contrast: 2:1 over heatmap may be fine but add a dashed pattern option for colorblind users.
- For keyboard users, ensure the slider exposes aria-valuetext and aria-valuenow and that the pill has aria-describedby linking to tooltip text in DOM.

ux-bot: Checklist added to ticket INFR-4501:
- [ ] Horizon marker accessible text and estimated badge when sampled
- [ ] Sampling slider hit target >=44px with visible DOM readout
- [ ] Sampling_percent attached to query metadata
- [ ] 'S' shortcut wired and telemetry on usage
- [ ] Low-confidence pill state (orange) with accessible description
- [ ] Heatmap horizon line has dashed pattern fallback

Riley Park: Thanks! I'll update Figma with dashed horizon variant and both tooltip microcopy options. Scheduling 15m playtest Fri 10:30am PT to validate keyboard flow and pill contrast. Invite: @June Kim @Gwen Ortiz @Marco Li.
